errors.name: RoomNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested room is not found in the system.

errors.name: GuestNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested guest is not found in the system.

errors.name: BookingNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested booking is not found in the system.

errors.name: RoomConflictError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to book a room during a period that overlaps with an existing booking.

errors.name: InvalidDateError
errors.description: Raised when a date provided for check-in or check-out is invalid (e.g., before today or improperly formatted).

errors.name: InvalidBookingDataError
errors.description: Raised when booking data contains invalid values, such as a check-out date before the check-in date.
